'''Oxenbrigg''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Crew chief/Legends|crew chief]] of a [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] hull-integrity maintenance crew. Due to his expertise in maintaining vessels, he gave a report stating some details on what hazards to look out for when traveling in [[Realspace/Legends|deep space]], in particular fauna that pose a threat to various vessels such as [[Mynock/Legends|Mynocks]] and [[Exogorth/Legends|Space slugs]]. His report was later included in the official field manual for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''.
